Container.Name: jack
Container.Overview: jack lets you and your friends share your Radarr/Sonarr libraries with each other. It registers itself in your Radarr/Sonarr as a Torznab indexer and a qBittorrent download client, and downloads files straight from your friends' jacks. This is the server; install jack-ui next to it for the web interface. Setup guide: https://github.com/LeetDonkey/jack/blob/main/website/guide/unraid.md
Container.Requires: A Docker network named "jack" (Unraid terminal: docker network create jack). Radarr and/or Sonarr.

Config.Name: Peer and *arr port
Config.Description: Port your Radarr/Sonarr use to reach jack, and your reverse proxy forwards your friends to. Never forward it straight from your router: put a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: config.jsonc, the database and logs. jack creates a default config here on first start.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movie library, so jack can share it. IMPORTANT: click Edit and set the Container Path to EXACTLY the path your Radarr container uses for this folder (its root folder, e.g. /movies or /data/media/movies). Read-only. Remove this if you don't share movies.

Config.Name: TV
Config.Description: Your TV library. Set the Container Path to EXACTLY the path your Sonarr container uses (e.g. /tv or /data/media/tv). Read-only. Remove this if you don't share TV.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where jack puts finished downloads for Radarr/Sonarr to import. Radarr and Sonarr must see this same folder at the same Container Path. Example: if your Radarr maps /mnt/user/downloads to /data, keep /data/jack here with the host path /mnt/user/downloads/jack.

Config.Name: Internal URL
Config.Description: http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:5225 (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5225), the address Radarr/Sonarr use to reach jack. Only read when jack creates its config on first start; change it later in jack-ui under Settings.

Config.Name: Management key
Config.Description: A long random secret that jack-ui uses to talk to jack. Generate one in the Unraid terminal with: openssl rand -hex 32. Use the same value in jack-ui.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn or error.
